item.text:
Refactored the simulation support layer around state correctness rather than just cleanup. In [Disease.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R003_module_java/Disease.java:16), disease progression is now per-instance instead of shared across every diseased animal, which fixes a real behavioral bug. I made the same timer logic explicit in [Carcass.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R003_module_java/Carcass.java:14), and fixed the old countdown edge case where some carcasses could never become diseased.

I also made time and weather resettable simulation systems instead of implicit global state. [TimeSystem.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R003_module_java/TimeSystem.java:42) now has an explicit reset path and clearer day/night boundaries, [WeatherSystem.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R003_module_java/WeatherSystem.java:30) can be reset cleanly, and [Simulator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R003_module_java/Simulator.java:239) now reinitializes those systems on startup and on `reset()`. That prevents cross-run leakage in weather/day tracking. I also standardized random gender selection in [Gender.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R003_module_java/Gender.java:14) to use `Randomizer` instead of `Math.random()`, which keeps simulation randomness deterministic under the shared seed.
